_note: KSJC Norman Y. Mineta San Jose Intl. Dimensions are approximate -- verify with the current Chart Supplement / airport diagram. Headings are not needed: winds are expressed as components relative to the runway.

12L.ahead_notes: SE of airport: dense urban San Jose (downtown, I-880, Hwy 87, Coleman/Guadalupe corridor) -- very few off-airport options.

12R.ahead_notes: SE of airport: dense urban San Jose -- very few off-airport options.

30L.ahead_notes: NW of airport: Guadalupe Slough / Alviso salt ponds / SF Bay shoreline -- water and marsh beyond the runway end; limited roads.

30R.ahead_notes: NW of airport: Guadalupe Slough / Alviso salt ponds / SF Bay shoreline.

_infield_note: Half-width of airport property around the runway centerline treated as 'on-airport' for CAPS canopy touchdown. Crude -- refine from the airport diagram.

departure_points._note: remaining_ft = pavement left ahead of brake release. Full-length = runway length. Shorter values emulate intersection departures (check the diagram for actual taxiway intersections).

_geo_note: Thresholds (lat/lon of the pavement end the takeoff roll starts from) and true headings from OurAirports (FAA-derived). 12L/30R and 12R/30L are both 11,000 ft; displaced thresholds (landing only) are ignored. Spacing 748 ft computed from the coordinates.
